title: Federal Civil Service Annuity Increases in the Veterans Pension Benefit Income Statement
content:
A federal civil service annuity under the Federal Employees Retirement System receives the reduced cost-of-living increase that system grants each December. In a veteran's benefit income statement on his Veterans Pension award, his annuity figure is raised by the age of its level — the whole months from the date that level took effect, as shown on his most recent annuity report, to the date of the statement — the date the statement carries, the day the change began, and not the day the veteran files it:

- an annuity figure whose level took effect **24 or more** whole months before the statement is raised by the two most recent of those increases together — multiplied by **1.0404**;
- one that took effect **12 to 23** whole months before is raised by the most recent one — multiplied by **1.02**;
- one **under 12** whole months old is stated as reported — multiplied by **1**.

The raised figure is rounded to the cent.

### Schedule applied to a hypothetical annuity of 18000.00

| Whole months since the level took effect | Stated annuity |
|---|---|
| 0 to 11 | 18000.00 |
| 12 to 23 | 18360.00 |
| 24 or more | 18727.20 |

At 11 whole months the figure is unchanged; at 12 it takes the single reduced increase; at 23 it still takes one increase; at 24 it takes the two together.
